_comment: Full TTA + LLM correction pipeline: LoadImage → KrakenLineSegmentation → PreprocessLineImages → TTAEnsembleTrOCR → LLMHTRCorrection → TextOutput. The original image is also wired to LLMHTRCorrection for multimodal grounding. Node wiring: 1→2(image), 2→3(cropped_lines), 4→5(model), 3→5(preprocessed_images), 5→6(all_hypotheses_json), 1→6(image for multimodal), 6→7(corrected_text), 2→8(annotated_image preview).

_meta.title: Preprocess Line Images
_meta.note: Normalises line crops to clean black-on-white for TrOCR. Receives cropped_lines from KrakenLineSegmentation output [0].

_meta.title: TTA Ensemble TrOCR
_meta.note: Outputs: [0]=transcription (STRING, newline-joined winners), [1]=all_hypotheses_json (STRING, full JSON for LLM correction). Receives preprocessed_images from PreprocessLineImages [0] and model from LoadTrOCRModel [0].

inputs.context_hint: 19th century German civil registry document (Geburtsurkunde/Heiratsurkunde/Sterbeurkunde). May contain German personal names, place names in Prussia/Pommern, standard civil registry phrases, abbreviations like geb. (geborene), i/Pom. (in Pommern), Str. (Straße).

_meta.title: LLM HTR Correction (Ollama)
_meta.note: Post-corrects TTA transcription using a language model. Receives all_hypotheses_json from TTAEnsembleTrOCR output [1] and the original image from LoadImage output [0] for multimodal grounding. Output [0]=corrected_text (STRING).

_meta.title: Corrected Transcription Output
_meta.note: Set save_to_file=true and output_path to a filename (e.g. transcription_llm.txt) to save results to disk. Receives corrected_text from LLMHTRCorrection output [0].

_meta.title: Annotated Lines Preview
_meta.note: Shows detected line polygons overlaid on the original image. Uses KrakenLineSegmentation output [3]=annotated_image.
